path.data-text: Put the DOS disk in drive A, or the CD in its drive.
Type A:\SETUP and press Enter. Quill goes in
Start it with QUILLDOS. To remove it, run SETUP /U
In Program Manager choose File, Run, and type
Quill goes in C:\QUILL with its own Program Manager
To remove it, use Uninstall Quill in that group.
